<b>Coral Furms</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are dark-furred bugs protecting themselves with spiked coral nuts.<ref>Coral Furm [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Dark-furred bug protecting itself with a spiked coral nut."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Crawls along the floor, turning around once it reaches an edge or a wall. If Hornet approaches, it rears back and rushes forward with its spiked shell, taking much less knockback as it charges.

Sometimes hides inside clusters of similar-looking spiky coral and breaks out when Hornet approaches.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* The crust covers...
* The crust conceals...
* Our shells made strong...
* Our nest made secret...
}}

== Location ==
Coral Furms can be found in [[Sands of Karak]].
